apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.10 — The swara editor gains a Cancel button in both studios. The editor saves live, so Cancel is a true restore: it puts back the phrase exactly as it was when the editor opened (or clears it, if nothing was saved), including the song's remembered raga and, in Compose, the composition name.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
